Chrome is built on the open-source Chromium project and uses the Blink rendering engine to display web pages. It also features automatic updates, extensive extension support, and cross-platform availability, making it popular for both personal and professional use.

title: ArduinoIDE
description: The Arduino IDE (Integrated Development Environment) is a user-friendly software platform used to write, compile, and upload code to Arduino boards.

Board and Port Selection: Easily select your connected Arduino board and communication port (USB or serial). Allows real-time communication between your computer and the Arduino board for debugging or data visualization. Includes a wide range of libraries for various sensors, modules, and features like WiFi, Bluetooth, or motor control. Code written in the Arduino IDE is called a sketch, stored with a .ino file extension. Available for Windows, macOS, and Linux. The IDE itself is open-source, meaning you can modify and adapt it for your specific needs.

title: VLC
longDescription: Cross-platform media player VLC (VideoLAN Client) is a free, open-source, and cross-platform media player developed by the VideoLAN project. It supports a wide range of multimedia file formats, including videos, audio, DVDs, and network streams. VLC is known for its versatility, lightweight design, and ability to play almost any media format without requiring additional codecs. It is available for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS.

title: OBS

It's popular among content creators, streamers, and broadcasters due to its flexibility, advanced features, and compatibility across multiple operating systems (Windows, macOS, and Linux). OBS is maintained by a large community and is particularly favored for live streaming on platforms like Twitch, YouTube, and Facebook Live.

title: Bandicam

title: Gimp
longDescription: Free and open-source raster graphics editor GIMP (GNU Image Manipulation Program) is a free and open-source raster graphics editor. It is widely used for tasks such as: Photo retouching and editing: Adjusting colors, brightness, contrast, and removing imperfections. Image composition: Combining multiple images or elements into a single cohesive design. Graphic design: Creating logos, icons, and other graphics. Digital art: Drawing and painting with various tools like brushes, layers, and masks. File format conversion: Converting images between different file formats. GIMP is cross-platform, available for operating systems like Windows, macOS, and Linux. It is highly customizable with support for plugins, scripts, and extensions, making it a powerful tool for both beginners and advanced users.

title: Wine
description: Enjoy Windows programs on Linux and macOS
longDescription: Wine (originally an acronym for 'Wine Is Not an Emulator') is a compatibility layer capable of running Windows applications on several POSIX-compliant operating systems, such as Linux, macOS, & BSD. Instead of simulating internal Windows logic like a virtual machine or emulator, Wine translates Windows API calls into POSIX calls on-the-fly, eliminating the performance and memory penalties of other methods and allowing you to cleanly integrate Windows applications into your desktop.
